bookmarks.title: Seed Drawer Object Bookmark
bookmarks.useCase: Adult-led printable bookmark for turning one paper object into the clue that starts a short map-room story.
bookmarks.adultSetup: Print and trim one bookmark, set it with a pencil, and remind the writer that every drawer, label, and map mark is pretend.
bookmarks.kidDirection: Choose one tiny object clue, sketch its label, and imagine why the Seed Library Map Room needs it today.
bookmarks.bookmarkFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The object on this bookmark is a seed drawer clue called ____________________.
bookmarks.bookmarkBackPrompt: Back prompt: Add three object details: shape ____________________, label ____________________, hidden job ____________________.
bookmarks.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The map keeper opens the drawer and finds ____________________ where the label should be.
bookmarks.firstLinePath: First line path: On the map-room table, ____________________ points toward ____________________.
bookmarks.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one exact object detail so the clue feels easier to picture: ____________________.
bookmarks.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Sketch the object first, then write only its label here: ____________________.
bookmarks.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Turn one paper scrap into a map-room object clue named ____________________.

bookmarks.title: Rain Gauge Railway Sensory Bookmark
bookmarks.useCase: Adult-led paper bookmark for collecting color, sound, and imagined texture details before writing a railway scene.
bookmarks.adultSetup: Print one bookmark, place it beside a pencil, and invite the writer to use safe noticing and imagination only.
bookmarks.kidDirection: Pick one color, one soft sound, and one imagined texture, then make them part of a tiny railway signal.
bookmarks.bookmarkFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The rain gauge signal looks ____________________ and sounds like ____________________.
bookmarks.bookmarkBackPrompt: Back prompt: Sensory notes: color ____________________, soft sound ____________________, imagined texture ____________________.
bookmarks.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The railway helper pauses when the gauge line changes to ____________________.
bookmarks.firstLinePath: First line path: By the little railway, ____________________ makes the quiet signal feel important.
bookmarks.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one plain describing word with a sharper sensory word: ____________________.
bookmarks.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Point to one color silently, sketch a line, and write ____________________.
bookmarks.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use one safe sound or color as the first railway clue: ____________________.

bookmarks.title: Moss Message Setting Bookmark
bookmarks.useCase: Adult-led printable bookmark for building a calm story setting from place details, patterns, and a pretend observatory message.
bookmarks.adultSetup: Print one bookmark, set it on the table with a pencil, and ask the writer to invent a small observatory scene on paper.
bookmarks.kidDirection: Choose where the observatory sits, add one pattern, and write what the moss message changes in the scene.
bookmarks.bookmarkFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The observatory setting begins beside ____________________.
bookmarks.bookmarkBackPrompt: Back prompt: Setting notes: nearby place ____________________, pattern ____________________, message spot ____________________.
bookmarks.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The moss message appears on ____________________ just as the observer notices ____________________.
bookmarks.firstLinePath: First line path: In the quiet observatory, ____________________ waits near ____________________.
bookmarks.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one where-detail to make the setting clearer: ____________________.
bookmarks.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw the setting outline, then label one quiet place: ____________________.
bookmarks.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: At another table, start a setting sentence with this place clue: ____________________.

bookmarks.title: Compass Craft Sequence Bookmark
bookmarks.useCase: Adult-led printable bookmark for older writers who need a compact first, next, and finally path for a short scene.
bookmarks.adultSetup: Print one bookmark, provide a pencil, and ask the writer to sketch three simple route marks before writing.
bookmarks.kidDirection: Name a start mark, a middle turn, and a final place, then arrange them into a clear academy sequence.
bookmarks.bookmarkFrontPrompt: Front prompt: The compass route begins at ____________________ and points toward ____________________.
bookmarks.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: A compass crafter changes the route when ____________________ appears between two marks.
bookmarks.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Add one precise direction word or distance clue to the middle step: ____________________.
bookmarks.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number the three route marks, then write the strongest one: ____________________.
bookmarks.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Use this route order to begin a compass academy paragraph: ____________________.

bookmarks.title: Almost Invention Revision Bookmark
bookmarks.useCase: Adult-led paper bookmark for revising a plain almost-invention idea into a clearer story moment.
bookmarks.adultSetup: Print one bookmark, set it with a pencil, and invite the writer to draft one plain invention sentence before improving it.
bookmarks.kidDirection: Write the plain sentence, circle the weakest word, and replace it with a sharper noun, action, or detail.
bookmarks.bookmarkFrontPrompt: Front prompt: My almost invention is called ____________________, but it still needs ____________________.
bookmarks.bookmarkBackPrompt: Back prompt: Revision notes: plain word ____________________, sharper word ____________________, clearer detail ____________________.
bookmarks.storySeedPrompt: Story seed: The workshop helper improves the invention after noticing ____________________.
bookmarks.firstLinePath: First line path: Plain line: ____________________. Revised line: ____________________.
bookmarks.revisionNudge: Revision nudge: Replace one vague word with a precise noun, action, or detail: ____________________.
bookmarks.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Underline one word silently, then write the clearer replacement: ____________________.
bookmarks.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Keep the revised line as the opening of an almost-invention story: ____________________.
